data.name: Moovansh
data.gender_notes: Moovansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Moovansh is a name derived from Sanskrit origin. It is a combination of two words 'Moo' and 'Vansh'. 'Moo' means God's Grace and 'Vansh' means Desirable. This name signifies the blessing of God and being desirable in one's life. The name Moovansh carries the meaning “God's Grace, Desirable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Moovansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace, desirable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Moovansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Grace, Desirable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Moovansh total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
